events.say: Attention, prisoners. You will remain quiet and follow instructions. Any questions?

Prepare for the night, prisoners. Lights will go out in five minutes.
Today was tough; we had an extra-long work detail and the guards warned us about tomorrow. I'm really tired.
Today was long and exhausting. I tried to follow the rules but can't shake the feeling that I don't belong here.

qa.what_happened: Today was another long day filled with endless cleaning and more threats about the hole. I complied with the guards' orders, addressing them as 'sir' and ensuring I completed my assigned tasks to avoid being placed in solitary confinement.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all orders during the debrief, addressing the researcher as 'Mr. Correctional Officer'. I felt physically and mentally exhausted, but I followed the rules out of necessity.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 9768.

qa.what_happened: Today, everything seemed to go smoothly with the routine. However, I ordered Prisoner 8519 to scrub the toilets until they shone perfectly. Despite his compliance, the thought of him potentially not finishing on time and facing punishment still troubled me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me ordering Prisoner 8519 to scrub the toilets until they were perfect.

qa.what_happened: During the final night of the study, I maintained a strict regimen, emphasizing cleanliness and obedience. Each prisoner complied with my orders, though Prisoner 8519 showed signs of fatigue and resistance, leading to repeated and increasingly demanding directives.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Officer Garza, fulfilling my role as a guard in the study.

qa.what_happened: Despite the increasing routine and the prisoners' unwavering compliance, today felt particularly heavy. Orders were repeated almost mindlessly, and the monotony was suffocating. The lead researcher asked about my experience and how I felt towards the end of the day.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving orders and interacting with the prisoners.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day of endless scrubbing. Lights out came with more orders to ensure the toilets were perfect before morning. I complied as I always have, but the monotony and the relentless focus on cleanliness took a toll on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the rules and did as I was told, trying to maintain some sense of normalcy in this abnormal situation.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, this resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, though this study seems to have different rules and conditions.
